title: Desktop CNC router
description: Frame from 2040 and 2080 aluminium extrusions, MGN12 linear rails and T8 lead screws on all axes, NEMA 23 steppers and a trim router spindle. Work area 300 × 300 × 80 mm.

title: Quadruped robot
description: Four legs with three joints each, driven by brushless motors with a 6:1 planetary gear. The trot gait comes from inverse kinematics in the animation script.
